description: Use when an agent must identify a South Korean company before looking up its profile or public-procurement record. Input: one of business_number (10 digits), dart_corp_code, stock_code (KRX, e.g. 005930) or q (company name, exact match ignoring 주식회사/(주)/spacing); first wins. Output: JSON companies with stable companyId, Korean and English names, stock code, DART code, match type, ambiguous flag. Data: OpenDART, KONEPS. Example: ?stock_code=005930 Price: $0.002 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

q.description: Company name (Korean or English), matched exactly after removing legal-form words

name: kr_company_resolve
title: Korean company resolver: name, business number or stock code to one stable company_id
